links.outcome: Hip fracture detection accuracy, sensitivity, specificity before vs after design thinking with clinicians
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 0.91 (0.84-0.96) to 0.95 (0.93-0.97); sensitivity stayed 0.97; specificity rose from 0.84 (0.71-0.93) to 0.93.
links.quote: By incorporating design thinking, we improved the diagnostic accuracy from 0.91 (0.84-0.96) to 0.95 (0.93-0.97), the sensitivity from 0.97 (0.89-1.00) to 0.97 (0.94-0.99), and the specificity from 0.84 (0.71-0.93) to 0.93(0.990-0.97).

screen.reason: Evaluated the impact of applying a structured design thinking process (user interviews and iterative refinement based on clinician needs) on model performance compared to baseline.

primary.practice: human-centered design thinking in model development
